name: Matterport Embed
project_description:
An unoffical module to render Matterport iframes.

 This module provides a custom field type, widget, formatter .

 Possible to create custom styles. 

 
 Rectangle (Example: 400px * 200px) 
 Square (Example: 500px * 500px) 
 Responsive (Example: 16/9) 
 
 Possible to create custom option sets. That allow you to define settings for different URL Parameter options.

 
 Custom URL Parameter (Key - Value) 
 Some extra settings 
 
 How to use it? 

- Enable module

- Add “Matterport Embed” field to your entity

- Configure “Matterport Embed Formatter” in your entity display
